name: Vincom Center Dong Khoi
summary: Shopping tower at Lê Thánh Tôn and Đồng Khởi: shop the mall on the walk from the cathedral toward the river. The building is at 72 Lê Thánh Tôn and 45A Lý Tự Trọng, about 750 metres from Bạch Đằng. It sits with Saigon Centre–Takashimaya.
getThere: On the Đồng Khởi walk, at 72 Lê Thánh Tôn.
kicker: The mall at Lê Thánh Tôn
heroCaption: The glass tower and the VINCOM name, at Lê Thánh Tôn and Đồng Khởi
body: Vincom Center is the shopping tower paired with Saigon Centre–Takashimaya. It stands at 72 Lê Thánh Tôn and 45A Lý Tự Trọng, Phường Bến Nghé, about 750 metres from Bạch Đằng. The photograph is that corner: the glass tower, the VINCOM letters, and the street signs for Lê Thánh Tôn and Đồng Khởi.
The second photograph is the same tower from across the junction, with the cantilevered roof against the sky. The visit is the mall on the walk between the cathedral and the river.

figures.caption: The tower from across the junction, with the roof overhang
figures.alt: Vincom Center tower seen across the street in Ho Chi Minh City

gettingThere: Walk Đồng Khởi to the corner of Lê Thánh Tôn, at 72 Lê Thánh Tôn and 45A Lý Tự Trọng, about 750 metres from Bạch Đằng.
